title: Control Plane Ops: Weekly Snag Log & Action Items (2026-10-02)
body:
Meeting: Control Plane weekly sync (quick snag log)
Date: 2026-10-02
Attendees: Jordan, Priya, Liam, Evelyn, Marco (+ async notes from Ana, Sam)
Duration: 35m (trimmed)

TL;DR:
- Two customer-facing effects observed this week: transient throttling for mid-size tenants (routing quotas) and a 1-2hr auth token churn that caused elevated 401s for some Dedicated tenants. Both are low-frequency but high-impact for a few customers; hit our latency/error SLOs on Tuesday window.
- Immediate mitigations applied; we outlined a staged fix + monitoring upgrades and a canary/rollback plan.

Observed signals / metrics:
- Routing quota churn: sudden quota recalculation triggered ~03:12 UTC on 2026-09-30. Result: per-tenant available-requests decreased ~35% for affected tenants for ~18 minutes. Symptoms: elevated 429s for 6 tenants, CPU on router pods +22%. p95 request latency increased from ~120ms -> ~460ms in the affected window.
- Auth token churn: after a credential rotation test, some worker nodes briefly used cached keys that were stale; saw a spike in 401s starting 05:45 UTC, lasting ~70 minutes. Affected path: private-controlplane v2 endpoints for Dedicated customers behind the private routing tier.
- KV cache eviction: correlated with routing quota events — eviction rate spiked, causing cache miss ratio for prefix cache to climb from 3% to 21%. This amplified cost and latency.

Root-cause hypotheses (initial):
1) Quota recalculation off-by-one in new quota window code path (suspect loop boundary introduced in PLT-4821) — leads to underreporting of available tokens for tenants with >10k qps-month.
2) Auth rotation script timing + stale cache interaction — if nodes rotate but a subset doesn't refresh their short-lived service token, requests get 401 until rotation completes and optional backfill catches up.
3) Cache pressure: the quota dip triggered rapid cache invalidation; current eviction policy is too aggressive on bursts.

Immediate mitigations applied (what we did already):
- Priya increased routing soft limits for "dedicated" tier by 12% around 04:10 UTC to reduce customer-visible 429s (temporary guardrail).
- Jordan rolled back GH: redwood/controlplane#937 from canary to 0% (it contained a non-blocking optimization that appears to change quota timing).
- Marco restarted auth refresh workers on the impacted zone to force token re-sync; this reduced 401s within ~20m.
- Emergency dashboard added: per-tenant quota delta + KV eviction rate panel (temporary tile on Console).

Proposed fixes (short/medium term):
- Short term (hotfix): patch PLT-4821 to fix boundary condition in quota window calculation. PR target: PLT-4867. Testing: unit tests + small synthetic load. Rollout: canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% if green. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-10-04 for canary.
- Medium term: strengthen auth rotation invariant: add double-check step where nodes validate rotated token with controlplane endpoint before marking rotation done. Also add metric and alert for stale-token-rate. Owner: Marco. ETA: 2026-10-10.
- Cache tuning: change prefix cache eviction from aggressive LRU to TTL-based hybrid for spikes > X rps. Experiment on staging with traffic replay. Owner: Evelyn. ETA: 2026-10-08 to have a tested config.

Rollout / rollback plan for quota hotfix (brief):
- Canary 10% for 2h, watch: per-tenant 429 rate, p95 latency, CPU on router pods, KV eviction. If no regressions and 429s drop for canary tenants -> expand to 30% for 4h. If stable -> 100% next overnight window. Rollback immediate if 5xx increase > 0.5% absolute.

Open action items (concrete):
- Priya Nair: open hotfix PR for quota boundary (link in JIRA PLT-4867), add unit tests for edge windows; target canary 2026-10-04.
- Jordan Chen: temporarily relax per-tenant soft limits for affected tenants and document mitigations; coordinate with CS for customer comms; done 2026-10-02 (monitoring).
- Evelyn Park: create a permanent dashboard tile for per-tenant KV hit/miss histograms and add a simple pager on >15% eviction spikes; target 2026-10-06.
- Marco Ruiz: add pre-check to auth rotation job and a synthetic canary that verifies token acceptability; plan chaos-run 2026-10-07.
- Liam O'Connell: load-test the TTL-hybrid eviction policy in staging with traffic replay dataset; results due 2026-10-08.

Customer outreach / CS notes:
- CS already informed two impacted Dedicated customers with note and short RCA placeholder. No escalations yet but both requested timeline — Jordan to coordinate.

Risks & unknowns:
- The quota undercount only shows up for tenants with certain traffic shapes (bursty vs sustained). We need more telemetry to classify affected tenants so the hotfix doesn't create overprovisioning for everyone.
- Auth rotation edge-case may be exacerbated by cross-region propagation delays (rare, but seen on Tuesday) — increasing token TTL buys time but increases attack surface window. Trade-offs to discuss with security.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Longer-term: automated tenant classification + adaptive quotas (batch compute to recommend per-tenant buffers). Owner: product + platform (discuss Q4 roadmap).
- Add end-to-end test that performs a simulated rotation + immediate traffic burst to ensure tokens accepted.

Notes / links referenced in discussion:
- PLT-4821 (quota window prototype) — suspected regression
- PLT-4867 (hotfix ticket) — created and assigned to Priya
- GH PR redwood/controlplane#937 — rolled back from canary
- Temp console tile: /console/platform/ops/temporary/quota-kv-tiles (internal)

Next check-in:
- Quick async updates in #platform-ops channel over next 48h (Priya to post canary start + metrics).
- Full sync next week: 2026-10-09 09:30 PT (agenda: canary review, auth pre-check implementation plan, KV eviction experiment results).

Appendix (scratch):
- Quick reproduction notes: small script to simulate quota window boundary presented in notes (ran locally by Priya, attached to PLT-4867).
- Slack snippets: Sam observed the initial 429 spike and posted logs (copied to PLT-4821 thread).

Status summary (owner checkpoint):
- Priya: hotfix in progress (blockers: need one more unit test to catch edge-case).
- Marco: auth rotation pre-check design drafted; needs review from security.
- Evelyn: dashboard wireframe complete; waiting on metrics endpoint change.
- Jordan: customer comms drafted; to be sent after canary success.

If anything urgent appears, escalate in #platform-ops and tag on-call.

-- end of notes --
